headline: The Grand Slam of Darts group stage ends this afternoon, and England's third ODI in Hobart is Tuesday night.
today: 2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts, final group games for Groups A to H, ESPN+/Hulu Live.
7:30 PM: Canadiens at Rangers, Hulu Live.
Tue 10:30 PM: Australia v England, 3rd ODI in Hobart, Willow.

recaps.text: Kyren Wilson beat Chris Wakelin 10-8 in the Champion of Champions final in Leicester on Sunday, his third title in a row.
Stephen Bunting is out of the Grand Slam of Darts after a 5-2 loss to Cameron Menzies, who won Group D.

lookAhead: Saturday has England v New Zealand at 9:10 AM and Arsenal at Newcastle at 12:30 PM; the Jets visit the Chargers on Sunday at 4:05 PM.
